name: @twiza/share-image-backfill
description: Drains claim_share_image_jobs: resizes each 'before' report photo's already-uploaded full-resolution image down to an 880px share image (photos.share_path), the /r/<id> and live /a/<id> hero image. Runs on a GitHub Actions runner, not a Supabase Edge Function — decoding an image on a cold Edge worker has twice blown its CPU budget on this project (magick-wasm, Satori).
